physicalEvidence.status: Verified current-host supervised physical prototype, with limited evaluation and external sensing
physicalEvidence.summary: March 2025 master’s thesis verifies Corah-supervised Mines experiments: GPT-4o parameterizes predefined filming actions; offboard YOLO-World/RealSense sensing and Kalman tracking guide conventional Crazyswarm2 waypoint execution on a real Crazyflie with Lighthouse positioning.20 successful indoor recordings include general maneuvers,10single-action and 5multi-action sequences. Failed flights were repeated without a denominator; no success rate is supported. The onboard camera was removed and displayed filming views are simulated. This is a limited language/perception-to-flight prototype, not learned low-level control or outdoor filming.
